text:
*Trump said Nvidia's ($NVDA) stock decline influenced his decision to intervene, expressing confidence in the market's response to Jensen Huang's reinstatement and calling it “a great thing for our country and even for the world.”*

• *Second Term* — Trump said Huang was extremely happy to return and calls it “his second term.”
• *Chip Roadmap* — Trump said Blackwell would be obsolete in a year and that Nvidia has two upcoming chips that are “blowing Blackwell away,” emphasizing Huang's importance to the company.
• *Return* — Trump has not spoken with Huang since his reinstatement but expects to speak with him before Monday, when he believes Huang essentially resumes his duties.
• *National Security* — Questioned about Huang's potential security risk and the lack of a proper DOJ investigation, Trump cited information available to him without disclosing specifics.
